title: Exceptional internal-Hom exchange preserves the mate of an open-restricted morphism
statement:
Fix the coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], $A=A_{E,n}$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Work in the finite-Tor constructible categories $D^b_{ctf}(-,A)$ with the canonical ordinary and exceptional adjunctions and composition comparisons of [def-trf-admissibility]. Let $C$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $j:W\hookrightarrow C$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $M,N\in D^b_{ctf}(C,A)$ and $f:M\to N$. Write $H=R\mathcal Hom_A(M,N)$, $H_W=R\mathcal Hom_A(Lj^*M,Rj^!N)$ using [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and let $\widetilde f:A_C\to H$ be the tensor–Hom transpose of $f$. Use the normalized open-purity comparison $Lj^*\simeq Rj^!$ of [prop-functor-package] to regard $Lj^*f$ as $f_W:Lj^*M\to Rj^!N$; let $\widetilde f_W:A_W\to H_W$ be its tensor–Hom transpose. Let $E_j:H_W\xrightarrow{\sim}Rj^!H$ be the canonical exceptional internal-Hom exchange of [lem-trf-exceptional-internal-hom-exchange] and $a:A_W\xrightarrow{\sim}Rj^!A_C$ the constant-pullback comparison followed by open purity. Then
$$E_j\circ\widetilde f_W=Rj^!(\widetilde f)\circ a.$$
All the comparisons in this equality are the specified ones, rather than arbitrary isomorphisms of the displayed objects.

source.place: §0.3(a)-(b), equation (0.3): section normalization of exceptional internal-Hom exchange.
